task.description: The task's CURRENT state after this call — for an idempotent no-op (task already existed / already at the target state), this is the pre-existing task, not a new one.

changed.description: true iff plan.md was actually written this call. false means the operation was a no-op: create found an identical existing task, or set_done's target was already at the requested state. Callers rely on this for idempotency — never infer 'success' from HTTP status alone.
